question: How large is run-to-run (seed) variation on this benchmark, and are the reported effects larger than it?

design.identical_except: the random seed, AND algorithm, algorithm_note, gspo_note, importance_sampling_level_source, seed, seed_source -- the pair is not single-variable, so the difference below is not a pure seed effect

GRPO_G4_lr1e5_seed3409.identical_except: the random seed, AND algorithm, algorithm_note, grad_accum_source, gspo_note, importance_sampling_level_source, seed, seed_source -- not single-variable against the first draw, so what it adds to the range is not a pure seed effect

design.benchmark: the same 252 classification rows for both

pre_registered_rule.statement: the learning-rate effect is not separable from seed noise if |seed difference| >= half of |lr effect|
pre_registered_rule.note: if this threshold is changed after the fact, that is a finding to report and not a knob to turn

seed_spread.reading: over 3 draws the range is 0.0357 (GRPO_G4_lr1e5_seed3408 0.6071 .. GRPO_G4_lr1e5_seed3409 0.6429), at or above half the learning-rate effect (0.0278), which is NOT the verdict the one-difference rule reached (|-0.0159| / |-0.0556| = 0.286) -- the extra draw is what moved the reading, and 5.2.2 has to be re-read against it
seed_spread.what_a_range_cannot_give: 3 draws give a range, not a variance estimate: a range is the distance between the extreme order statistics of the draws that exist, so it can only grow as draws are added and remains a lower bound on the spread the configuration actually has. It is more than a difference and less than a variance, and 3 draws are still few

extra_seeds.note: a draw enters this block only when both its predictions and the report they are parsed against are on disk; half a draw is not a draw and cannot be checked

replication_vs_sft.reading: not reproducible: the two seeds land on opposite sides of SFT (+0.0000 and -0.0159), so the seed moves the comparison by more than the comparison resolves

what_two_seeds_cannot_give: two draws give one difference and no interval on the spread, so this is a lower bound on seed variation: it can understate it and cannot overstate it. A real noise floor needs several seeds, which were not run.
structured_metrics_are_marginal: no per-row decomposition, so the paired apparatus does not apply to them; they are compared only in magnitude
